population_served: Ohio residents seeking mental health or substance use support
services: Free confidential behavioral health support and connection to local services, available 24 hours a day.
eligibility_and_intake: Call directly. No referral is required.
availability_note: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

population_served: Anyone seeking housing, shelter, treatment, food, utilities, transportation, or other community services

population_served: People seeking accredited recovery housing in Ohio

availability_note: Registry data is updated regularly, but openings must be confirmed with the residence.

population_served: People seeking help understanding certified recovery housing options

services: Information about certified recovery residences, quality standards, and how to use the state locator.

availability_note: This organization certifies and supports residences, but does not operate a single statewide intake bed line.
